layout.description:
Hello, I’m Yana Bourne, a portrait and lifestyle photographer based in London.

My work is rooted in a cinematic, natural, and effortlessly relaxed style. Whether it’s a portrait session, a family shoot, or a special event, I strive to capture moments that feel intimate, honest, and timeless.

To me, photography is an act of courage, a way to uncover the beauty that lives beneath the surface. I take time to connect with each person I photograph, to peel back the layers and reveal something raw, radiant, and real.

I love when people come alive in front of the camera - playful, sensual, wild, and free. Each shoot is a thoughtfully curated experience, often set to music, sometimes with a glass of champagne, and always with room for spontaneity. It’s often the unplanned moments that hold the most magic.

Yana Bourne
